exercises.title: Skim the essay (Ex. 6–7)
exercises.instruction: Read the essay quickly and answer the questions.

stimulus.text:
Some parents may think that while their children are preparing for important school exams, they shouldn't have sports lessons. This could be because they want them to focus on exam subjects more, like science and maths. For a similar reason, some parents think children should also stop painting and music lessons in the final school term so they can spend more time studying. However, I disagree with these views, and believe that children should continue to have sports lessons. These lessons help students keep healthy and happy during the exam period.

Firstly, schools need to encourage young people to follow a healthy lifestyle and get regular exercise. Many young people don't do enough exercise. They prefer to spend their free time indoors on their computers or watching TV than going to the park and playing tennis, or going cycling. Many people today are overweight and have health problems. There is a lot of information about eating healthily, but people often forget that regular exercise is equally important.

Secondly, exercise helps us feel less stressed and tired. It also improves memory and helps us think clearly. When students are studying for exams, it's a good idea to take regular breaks and do something active for 20 minutes. Exercise also helps us to concentrate better on difficult tasks and helps us sleep better at night. Doing exercise may even help students get better results in their exams.

In conclusion, I believe that students who are revising for important exams should continue to have sports lessons because regular exercise is good for their body and mind.
stimulus.caption: Essay question: Students who are studying for important school exams should stop sports lessons. Discuss.

exercises.title: Helen's email (Ex. 19)
exercises.instruction: Read Helen's email to Alice and answer the questions.

stimulus.text:
Hi Alice,

I think it's a good idea to play tennis or basketball. Playing sport is a good way to stay healthy. I don't think you should play computer games all day. You should make sure you get enough sleep every night, between seven and 10 hours. You don't have to study for hours and should try to take regular breaks. You should eat lots of fruit and vegetables and get lots of regular exercise. Being healthy gives you more energy and makes you feel good.

From,
Helen

exercises.title: Write an email giving Alice advice (Ex. 20)
exercises.instruction: Your friend Alice has asked for advice about living a healthy life. Write a reply (80–100 words). In your email: (1) say what activities Alice could do to stay healthy; (2) describe healthy activities and ways to relax; (3) say why it is important to live a healthy life. Use should / shouldn't / have to / don't have to.

checklist: Các hoạt động giữ sức khoẻ
Ít nhất một cách thư giãn
Dùng should / shouldn't và have to / don't have to đúng
rubric.sampleAnswer:
Hi Alice,

Thanks for your email. I think you should go cycling or play badminton after school, because doing sport is the best way to keep fit. You don't have to join an expensive gym – you can go running in the park for free. When you feel stressed, you should try yoga or go for a walk. You shouldn't stay up late on your phone, and you have to get at least eight hours of sleep. It's also important to drink lots of water. Being healthy gives you more energy and helps you study better.

Take care,
Linh
commonErrors: Nhầm don't have to (không bắt buộc) với mustn't (cấm)

exercises.instruction: Look at the two pictures (a man eating fruit and vegetables; a busy woman working). Speak for 1–2 minutes: give a general description, details, your opinion and advice with should / shouldn't.

items.prompt: Describe the two pictures. Talk generally about what you can see, give specific details, give your opinion and reasons, and give advice using should / shouldn't.
items.sampleAnswer: The first picture shows a man sitting at a table with a plate of fruit and vegetables. It looks like he is thinking about what to eat. I think he is trying to eat healthily, which is a good idea because fruit and vegetables give you lots of energy. Maybe he should also drink more water. In the second picture, I can see a woman in an office. There are lots of books and papers on her desk, and it looks like she is very busy and stressed. I think she is working very long hours. In my opinion, she shouldn't work all day without a break. She should go for a short walk or do some exercise, because that helps you feel less stressed. She should also get enough sleep.
items.sampleNote: Hai tranh, mỗi tranh đi đủ 3 bước; có lý do (because) và lời khuyên (should / shouldn't).
